name: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate

fee.note: Published exam-only price; includes two exam attempts and 12 months to schedule. Bundles with a course or a subscription cost more.

exam.format: Online, proctored multiple-choice exam: 60 questions in 90 minutes. No prerequisites. Passing CKA or CKAD renews the KCNA automatically.

scope: Foundational knowledge of Kubernetes and the cloud native ecosystem: Kubernetes fundamentals, container orchestration, cloud native application delivery and cloud native architecture.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.

prep.title: Linux Foundation: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Essentials (LFS250)
prep.note: Also sold in a bundle with the exam.

domains_note: Weights from the Linux Foundation certification page, 'Domains & Competencies' section, read 2026-11-17; the CNCF KCNA curriculum PDF gives the same weights.
